title: Place path controls in the window body

statement.en: Place a macOS path control in the window body, not the window frame.
statement.ja: macOS path controlはwindow frameではなくwindow bodyに配置する。

conditions: Do not place a path control in a toolbar or status bar.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Path controls experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるPath controlsの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。

manual: Does the design satisfy “Place a macOS path control in the window body, not the window frame.” in the documented Path controls context?

anti_patterns: Ignoring this guidance in a context where the source section applies.
positive_examples: A design review records how the implementation satisfies this rule and any source-scoped exception.
